description: Implementation of a manager for handling product images in a CMS using Infinispan caching. Contains methods for adding, retrieving, and removing product images, and interactions with the cache hierarchy and nodes.

classes.name: CmsImageFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Manager class that handles storing, retrieving, and removing product images in Infinispan cache, implementing multiple interfaces for product image operations.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, typically during servlet undeployment or shutdown.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern method to access the single instance of this manager.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to the cache under a specific node path based on merchant store, sku, and image size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image for a given product image object or detailed parameters including size.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Fetches all images associated with a merchant store or product.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specific product image based on product image details.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a product.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Internal helper to fetch or create a cache node for a specified path.
